text: The dataset that detected the 2021 tree-cover loss is the "Global Forest Change" dataset, version "GFC-2025-v1.13" provided by the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD). This is confirmed by the observation tool output, which states that the tree-cover loss in 2021 was observed by the Hansen GFC dataset. The loss area was 81.3 hectares, which is 2.23% of the asset area.
